3. 'Perspective distortion' (Severity 2.0): The keyboard rows show slight inconsistency in curvature and vanishing points, typical of AI struggling with rigid geometric grids.
I agree with the severities. The structural collapse of the lever is the most critical defect, preventing a high artifact score.
